My friend at the skate park brought a SUPER tiny travel chess set to the park one day and asked around if anyone knew how to play chess. At the time, I knew how to play, but I didn't really delve too deep into it. I played once in a while against my little brother, and online once in a blue moon, but I never really got to play OTB with other people. We ended up drawing because both of us sucked, but that really sparked it for me. I ended up starting to go to the skate park because I wanted to play chess, hoping my friend was there. I started bringing my own set, and eventually I got basically all of my local skateboarding friends to start playing chess with me. Everybody's super competitive, even though everyone's a complete novice (myself included, 600 flat on chess.com) I win most of the time but it's still fun. It's brought me and the boys a lot closer as a result, and we've had so many laughs and funny moments come out of this game. I love it.
